brief:
Coalition negotiations between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party and Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party have collapsed without reaching an agreement, Al Jazeera English reported. The two parties remained divided over leadership of the next government and whether far-right minister Itamar Ben-Gvir would participate in a coalition.

The breakdown leaves Netanyahu facing uncertainty as he attempts to form a governing majority. The sticking points—control of the premiership and Ben-Gvir's role in any future cabinet—reflect deeper fractures within Israel's political landscape following recent elections.
dek: Parties remain split over who will lead the next government and whether far-right minister Itamar Ben-Gvir will join.
title: Netanyahu's Likud, Eisenkot's Yashar end coalition talks without deal
